current: No sampling mechanism exists: Logger/logs.rs has no sample rate, and nothing else configures one. qip-edge's Cell::work makes no log call (cell.rs has 0 'logger.' hits and no eprintln). But the Reflex composition root logs per event on the decision thread. qip-edge-node's serve loop writes one eprintln! line for every requote outcome and every reconciliation break of each pass (main.rs:906,909; 'Every requote outcome, not only the failures'). A requote is minted once per book update when the touch moves past the threshold (qip-edge-node/src/reprice.rs:1-13), and each requote sends a cancel and a replacement. So stderr volume grows with message count instead of being bounded by a sample rate.
